scripts.build: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev:api: dotenv -e artifacts/api-server/.env.local -- ./node_modules/.bin/cross-env NODE_ENV=development corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && dotenv -e artifacts/api-server/.env.local -- corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
scripts.dev:frontend: dotenv -e artifacts/aida/.env.local -- corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/aida run dev
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "corepack pnpm run dev:api" "corepack pnpm run dev:frontend"
